decision.reason: [ev-cfc86d03a623] says only that Policy Exceptions and Cleanup Policies "graduated to a stable version (v2)". It bundles two separate API kinds and gives no API group or exact kind names. It also doesn't say what the earlier versions were or whether they stay served, are deprecated or are removed. The rest of the section [ev-963b8a5003cf][ev-131accbf2c98][ev-bc2d5eccce0f] covers deprecated policy fields, not this graduation, so it doesn't fill the gap. To decide applicability and consequence, we need the CRD or upgrade-guide text showing the GVKs and the status of the pre-v2 versions, split per kind.
